subject.title: fix(guarded-mkdir): allow in-root symlinked directory components

question: Should pinned writes accept directory symlink components that resolve inside the root in both the Python helper and Node fallback, or intentionally remain fallback-only?
rationale: Changing the Python helper's `O_NOFOLLOW` traversal is a security-contract choice, while merging fallback-only behavior creates environment-dependent API semantics.

options.title: Require cross-mode parity
options.body: Implement containment-preserving traversal in the Python helper and keep matching fallback behavior and tests before merge.

options.title: Accept fallback-only behavior
options.body: Merge only after explicitly documenting and testing that helper-enabled modes continue to reject these parents.

options.title: Retain universal rejection
options.body: Close or rework this PR and keep symlinked parent components unsupported in every mode.

recommendation.title: Require cross-mode parity
recommendation.body: Implement containment-preserving traversal in the Python helper and keep matching fallback behavior and tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available ownership signal for the pinned filesystem security contract and current release line.
